subject: How to automatically launch apps at server startup

messages.author: 1c44d55fe94f67dc
messages.subject: How to automatically launch apps at server startup
parts:
Hi all,
On a shiny server, I have several applications, each one in a different directory in /var/shiny-server/www.
the www directory contains an index.html which have the links to launch the applications.
When a user first shows the index.html and click on a hyperlink, there is around 10-15'' to view the page of the application. I think it is because the libraries needed by the app are launched on the server but it takes a "long" time.

Is there a mean to launch all the applications by default when the shiny-server is starting ? By this, I hope the connection to the different apps should be faster for the user.

Thanks for your help

Sam
